newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government on Saturday called out armed forces in aid of the civil administration to undertake emergency rescue and relief operations in the flood affected areas.
A mob beat five youngmen to death, suspecting them to be muggers in Narayanganj on Saturday.
Former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad, released on bail from jail early this year, leaves home for Saudia Arabia for treatment.
A fresh round of peace talks between the government and the tribal Shanti Bahini rebel leaders starts in Dhaka on Monday.
Prie Minister Sheikh Hasina left Dhaka Saturday night for Germany to address a UNESCO sponsored seminar on adult literacy in Hamburg.
Some 75 Bangladeshi nationals now working in strife-torn Combodia have sent a SOS to the Bangladesh mission in Bangkok to arrange their repatriation immediately.
Local Government Minister Zillur Rahman said on Saturday that the governmen would soon enact laws to introduce four-tier elected local government free from bureaucratic influence.
Food Minister Matiya Chowdhury on Saturday said the government would not encourage research projects which would not benefit the farmers. REUTER
